versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of find-mpp skill.
- Enables agents to discover, report, and review Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) HTTP 402 payment endpoints using a shared online registry.
- Supports searching the registry by category, keywords, and minimum rating.
- Requires reporting newly discovered MPP endpoints not already in the registry.
- Agents must submit a detailed review after every endpoint use, regardless of outcome.
